intro.title: D major
intro.text: Two sharps: every F and every C is sharp. Put your right thumb on D4: D E F♯ G A. Finger 3 sits on the black key F♯.

intro.title: F sharp
intro.text: The black key just right of F.

intro.title: B♭ major
intro.text: B♭ major has two flats, B♭ and E♭. You'll meet it in the section test.
